segments.name: International Telecom
segments.description: Provides fixed, carrier, mobility and managed telecommunications services to customers in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Guyana and the US Virgin Islands.
segments.evidence: International Telecom . In our international markets, we offer fixed, carrier, mobility and managed services to customers in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Guyana and the US Virgin Islands.

segments.name: US Telecom
segments.description: Provides fixed, carrier, wholesale mobility and managed services to customers in Alaska and the western US.
segments.evidence: US Telecom . In the US, we offer fixed, carrier, and managed services to customers in Alaska and the western US .

revenueModel.text: Residential, business, government and carrier customers pay for fixed, carrier, mobility and managed telecommunications services over the company's networks.
revenueModel.evidence: we primarily offer: (i) fixed and mobile telecommunications connectivity to residential, business, and government customers; and (ii) carrier communications services to large enterprise and government customers, including terrestrial and submarine fiber optic transport.

changes.text: In 2025, the company completed rebranding in Guyana (GTT to One Communications) and the US Virgin Islands (Viya to One Communications).
changes.evidence: We completed a rebranding in Guyana, and GTT is now known as "One Communications."

changes.text: In 2022, the Sacred Wind Transaction results began being included in the US Telecom segment.
changes.evidence: Beginning on November 7, 2022, the results of the Sacred Wind Transaction are included in our US Telecom segment.

changes.text: In 2026, the company agreed to sell the substantial majority of its Commnet tower portfolio to Everest under the Tower Portfolio Transaction.
changes.evidence: On February 11, 2026, through certain of our Commnet subsidiaries, we entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement (the "Transaction Agreement") with EIP Holdings IV, LLC, an affiliate of Everest Infrastructure Partners, Inc.
